name: WC2026 · Scandal editorial (manual trigger)
_description: Manual webhook trigger. You POST { team, source_url } and the workflow scrapes the article, drafts via prompts/scandal.md, renders template=scandal, and ALWAYS routes to Telegram for approval — never auto-publishes. This is the editorial layer; the model writes the draft, you press send.
_safety: This workflow MUST NOT auto-publish. The router is deliberately omitted — only the Telegram branch exists. Adding auto-publish here is how you get sued.

nodes.name: Webhook trigger
nodes.notes: POST to {n8n url}/webhook/scandal with body { team, source_url, fixture_id? }

nodes.name: Extract headline + quotes
nodes.notes: Strip HTML, pull headline + first 5 paragraphs. Feed as 'source' into the OpenAI prompt.

nodes.name: OpenAI · Draft (scandal prompt)
nodes.notes: System prompt = prompts/scandal.md. If output has empty slides[], the model has rejected the source — log and stop, don't send to Telegram.

nodes.name: Telegram · ALWAYS manual review
nodes.notes: Sends the draft caption + review_notes + first slide preview. You publish from your phone after reviewing.
